articleTitle: Improvised multi-robot cooperation strategy for hunting a dynamic target
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Hunting moving targets with random motions and behavior is a challenge for robotic systems, and it occupies a significant position in the research on coordination and cooperation in multi-robot systems. Cooperative hunting between robots is used in a wide range of fields such as industry, military, rescue and other fields. The aim of this paper is to present a new strategy for target hunting by means of a cooperative multi-robot system in two-dimensional space, especially moving targets with random and unexpected behavior. The strategy is inspired from the behavior of wolves in hunting, as it summarizes the roles of robots in the system in three roles: the leader wolf, the antagonist wolf, and the follower wolf. This diversity of roles contributed to improve the convergence performance of the algorithm and reduce significantly the pursuit time. The validity of this strategy is supported by computer simulations.

articleTitle: 5G Narrow-Band Band-Pass Filter using Parallel Coupled Lines and L-Shaped resonator
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: A new compact microstrip L-shaped resonator bandpass filter based on parallel-coupled lines is proposed for 28GHz, with the high performance for the fifth generation 5G. The aim of developing the geometry of the coupled lines is to obtain a narrowband and more compact size. The bandpass filter has been designed by Software CST Microwave, using Rogers4835 substrate having relative permittivity (ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>) of 3.66. The electromagnetic simulation results obtained of the compact microstrip L-shaped resonator bandpass filter has been compared with Advanced Design System ADS simulator. The bandpass filter has a bandwidth approximately from 27.5GHz to 29.4GHz, center frequency about 28GHz. Besides, it has high selectivity and a good return loss more than 20dB, with an overall size of 7×4×0.635mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Increasing the Performance of an IDS using ANN model on the realistic cyber dataset CSE-CIC-IDS2018
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Our society, economy, and critical infrastructures have become largely dependent on computer networks and information technology solutions, on the other hand, cyber-attacks are becoming more sophisticated and thereby presenting increasing challenges in accurately detecting intrusions. Failure to prevent the intrusions could degrade the credibility of security services, e.g. data integrity, confidentiality, and availability. Different detection methods have been proposed to tackle computer security threats, which can be broadly classified into Anomaly-based Intrusion Detection Systems (AIDS) and Signature-based Intrusion Detection Systems (SIDS). One of the most preferred protection mechanisms is the machine learning based IDS which provide the most relevant results ever, but it still suffers from disadvantages like unrepresentative Dataset (the most of them were collected during a limited period of time in some specific networks and generally don’t contain up-to-date data). Additionally, they are imbalanced and do not hold sufficient data for all types of attack. These imbalanced and outdated datasets decrease the efficiency of current IDS, especially for new attack types. Some recent works proposed many machine-learning-based IDS based on an up-to-date security dataset CSE-CIC-IDS2018, in this paper we propose an experimental approach of Artificial Neural Networks with adapted hyper-parameters. Experimental results demonstrated that the proposed approach considerably improve the general accuracy.

articleTitle: A Compact SIW Bandpass Filter with Double slit Complementary Split Ring Resonator
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: In this work, we present a substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) bandpass filter, based on the double-slit complementary split ring resonator (DS- CSRR), with compact size. By incorporating one unit cell of DS- CSRR on the upper side of SIW cavity, the proposed filter offers good performance.. The bandpass is centered at 8.3 GHz with the corresponding fractional bandwidth of 18parcent. The simulation results show that the filter has a a high selectivity, the insertion losses and return losses in passband are about 0.4dB and 20dB respectively. In the process, two symmetrical slots are inserted in the feed lines to achieve a good suppression level in the stopband. The dimensions of the proposed filter are 18x07mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The presented filter is suitable for telecommunications applications.

articleTitle: Improving Vehicle Classification and Detection with Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Vehicle detection and classification are major functions of advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS). In this paper, a deep-learning approach for vehicle detection and classification is discussed and improved. More specifically, we utilized the state of the art object detection model “YOLOV4” with a clear focus on vehicles which made the detection process more robust. We conducted real life tests on vehicle images from Egypt at El-Sahil bridge, Imbaba and El-Hussary where our improved model detects the vehicles reliably. Our approach mainly relied on using ResNet50 and VGG16 as a classification backbones for YOLOv4, we used the GTI dataset to train and fine tune both networks to get the one with the better classification accuracy. The mean average precision (MAP) increased by 6.7% for VGG (84.49% to 91.02%) and 7.35% for ResNet (85.3% to 92.653%) then we trained YOLOv4 using OpenImages and Highway data sets for vehicle detection reaching an improvement of nearly 6.3% MAP (86.5% to 92.82%).

articleTitle: Nonlinear Output Feedback Control of Bidirectional dc-dc Power Converter for V2X BEV Charger: Theoretical Analysis and Experimental Results
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: In this paper, the control of the bidirectional dc-dc power converter for the V2X battery electric vehicle charger is processed. After accurate modeling of the studied system (dc-dc power converter associated with electric vehicle battery packs), a nonlinear output feedback controller is designed to meet two main objectives: (i) Estimating the battery state of charge (SOC), and (ii) Ensuring and safeguarding battery-charging and battery-discharging during grid-to-vehicle (G2V) and Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) operating modes, respectively. Finally, numerical simulations and experimental validation are performed which clearly illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: The Impact of Covid-19 on Connected and non-Connected Production Lines in the Automotive Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: At the time of writing this article, there have been 18 million confirmed cases of COVID-19 worldwide, many industries were affected hardly from the pandemic and thousands of companies closed their doors. The automotive industry was also hit by COVID-19 due to the large number of human resources in this industry (8,397,451 Employees).This project is based on comparing connected and non-connected production lines and studying the impact of COVID-19 pandemic on each on. The comparative study is done on two production lines in an automobile manufacturing company that assembles 650 car per day.We will analyze the impact of the virus spreading on the number of workers, Quality Rate, Output Rate and the Ergonomics level.

articleTitle: Design and electromagnetic Simulation of a 40 dBm Class-AB GaN power amplifier
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Because of the high increment in demand a wide arrangement of applications that require for low-cost, high-efficiency, and compact systems, RF power amplifiers are viewed as the most basic design blocks and power consuming components in wireless communication, radar, and TV transmission. Therefore, much research has been carried out in order to improve the performance of power amplifiers. This paper focuses on the design, electromagnetic Simulation and the harmonic balance analysis for a GaN 40 dBm class AB power amplifier operating at 3.7 GHz. The Transistor, Cree CGH 40010F GaN is choosed. It is a general purpose 10W transistor. The amplifier will operate at class AB and the suggested bias for this class is Vgate = -2.73V, Vdrain = 28V and iD= 200mA. the simulated output power is about 40 dBm, and the PAE is about 65%, and the gain >11 dB.

articleTitle: A Novel Compact Uwb Monopole Antenna With Reconfigurable Dual Band-Notch Characteristics For Wimax And Wifi 6e Bands
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: A compact ultra-wideband (UWB) monopole antenna with reconfigurable dual band-notch characteristics is exhibited in this paper. It is consisting of a reshaped rectangular patch with a partial ground plane including a rectangular slot. The dual band-notch property at WiMAX [3.3-3.6] GHz and WIFI 6E [5.925-7.125] GHz bands, are achieved by associating three open-ended slots on the radiating patch. for the purpose of achieving the reconfigurable dual band-notch performance, three metallic switches are inserted in the open-ended slots. Switching on or off the metallic strips enable or disable the bands notched and thus the reconfigurability is introduced. The antenna has a tiny size of 16*20mm. The simulated results indicate that the proposed antenna can provide a UWB mode ranging from [3-17.7] GHz, two single band-notch modes, and a dual band-notch mode. The software that was used for this simulation is the CST Microwave Studio (CST MWS). The antenna's current distribution and gain characteristics are also reviewed.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Effectiveness of Vertical Axis Wind Turbine for Domestic Consumers
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Depleting oil reserves and fossil fuels has changed the aspect of thought in energy sector and led to a strong focus on renewable energy sources. Wind energy sector is a potential area of research as the idea of micro grid and domestic power integration are in place. Wind turbines that can be used to harness the low wind velocities for power generation are of importance. Horizontal Axis Wind Turbines and vertical Axis Wind Turbines are the types of wind turbines used to convert wind energy to electrical energy. Horizontal Axis Wind Turbines provide good wind power conversion efficiency and are used in regions of moderate to high wind speeds and in regions of lower wind speeds, Vertical Axis Wind Turbines performance is satisfactory. In this work, the mathematical modeling of HAWT and different types of VAWTs are presented, followed by analysis of those turbine models under lower air velocities. The performance parameters used in this study are maximum power coefficient and output power which are standard performance metrics for wind power generation. The analysis reinforces the fact that, in domestic conditions, where the wind velocity in low, VAWTs provide superior performance.

articleTitle: Operating models of Network protocols IoT: Short-range protocols
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is a new and complex concept that has emerged in recent years. IoT form an extremely diverse family, constantly expanding, based on existing communication techniques and protocols. The diversity of network protocols responds to the heterogeneity of billions of communicating objects. There are dozens of different technologies, which each have their particularities in terms a set of criteria. However, the lack of a single connectivity protocol causes a lack of interoperability between IoT devices and applications. In this article, we will present the operating models of network Short-range protocols. There models facilitates the in-depth understanding of how network protocols work using the activity diagram. Subsequently, this will help to choose the adaptable protocol for a type of IoT applications. We classify the protocols into three categories. There is Short-range protocols, Medium range protocols and Long-range protocols. We focus on the Short-range protocols namely Bluetooth, Zigbee, and NFS.. We used the activity diagram, which is a behavioral diagram of UML; it allows to graphically representing the behavior of these protocols.

articleTitle: A High Gain Reconfigurable Frequency Antenna Multiband for Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: We propose in this letter, a new reconfigurable triangular antenna design with triangular-shaped slots. The proposed idea allowed us to have successfully a reconfigurable multiband operation based on PIN diodes. We got better results in terms of gain and bandwidth, we possess high gain achieved 5.23 dB and ultra-wideband witch can reach 1.68 GHz, thus, the antenna operates efficiently in the Universal Mobile Telecommunications System (UMTS) (1.92-2.1 GHz), the Broadband Personal Communications Service (PCS) (1.85-2 GHz), the S-band (2-4 GHz), the Worldwide Interoperability for Microwave Access (WiMAX) (3.5–3.6GHz, 5.25–5.85 GHz), the C-band (4 GHz to 6 GHz) and the Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) (IEEE802.11a/h/j/n 5.15-5.35GHz, 5.25-5.35GHz, 5.47-5.725GHz, 5.725-5.825GHz). Moreover, a compact antenna volume (60 × 60 × 1.6mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) is nominated in this approach, which can be implemented in portable electronic devices, in order to guarantee proper operation in divers wireless services.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy logic controller and PID optimization control strategy based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) for inventory management
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: The Control and Inventory management is a challenging problem area in supply chain management. A good Control and Inventory management is a system that can fulfil customer demand, decrease inventory cost, increase ROI (Return of Investment), taking into consideration the non-linearity of process. This paper presents a comparative performance between conventional controller PID and intelligent controllers (FPID and PIDPSO). The optimized values of tuning parameters for PIDPSO was achieved from the optimization of Integral of Square of Error (ISE), by running a PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) program. The effectiveness of the proposed controllers was demonstrated through simulation of data of an aerospace line assembly. By comparison, the performances of each controller, it was found that the PSO controller performed better than the Fuzzy controller and fuzzy gain scheduling.

articleTitle: Investigation on PID Controller Tuning Methods for Aircraft Fuselage Temperature Control
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Aircraft cabin temperature control is crucial in maintaining constant temperature inside the aircraft flying at high altitudes. In such altitudes, the atmospheric temperature and oxygen availability are very low in contrast to the requirements inside the aircraft. For constant monitoring and maintenance of temperature in real-time, the controller should be highly sensitive to parameter variations and hence require lower processing times for quick response. Traditional control method such as PID control offer faster response with lower computational overhead. In this work, model of aircraft temperature control system with PID controller is considered and different methods of finding the controller’s coefficients are presented. The comparison of methods is done and recommendations are made based on parameters such as overshoot, settling time and stability

articleTitle: Satellite network configuration to efficiently support multicast CDN applications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Recent 5G initiatives pave the way to enable cutting-edge services improving on performance and costs of the current TCP/IP applications. The key enabling technologies are those enabling virtualization of both the network components (i.e. SDN) and the Network Functions on the top (i.e. NFV). In the framework, the provisioning of CDN services could benefit from the intrinsic satellite broadcasting channel, if the satellite operators get ready to support such new communication paradigms. In the this paper, the author discusses on the network configuration updates needed in the satellite operator network in order to be efficiently involved in a dynamic and cost-effective deployment of an efficient CDN service based on the satellite multicast.

articleTitle: Parasitic Elements Extraction of the GaN HEMT Packaged Power Transistors based on S-parameter measurements
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: This paper presents a complete methodology based on an accurate S-parameters calibration procedure to determine parasitic resistances, inductances, and capacitances of a packaged GaN power transistor. Results show the possibility to extract very low device parasitics which may influence switching mechanisms in power converters. The accuracy of the S parameter characterization is verified on a SiC power MOSFET. Good agreement is found between extracted values and technical data provided in the literature. The extracted linear model of the tested GaN HEMT is simulated in the frequency domain using an S-parameters circuit simulator. The excellent match between the measurement and simulation indicates a high accuracy of the S-parameter extraction technique. The GaN HEMT parasitic elements are obtained from the S-parameters measured using a vector network analyzer and then converted to the impedance (Z) parameters. These parameters, through detailed network analysis, provide more accurate values of the internal parasitic inductances than the commonly used LCR meter measurement technique. The method has the capability to be applied to any packaged GaN power transistor fabricated by different manufacturers.

articleTitle: New Nine-Level PUC-NPC9 Inverter With Natural Balancing Of Capacitors Voltages
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: A new inverter with natural balancing of capacitors voltages is presented in this paper. The proposed topology which is based on the PUC and NPC topologies allows the possibility of generating nine levels at the output voltage while using a single DC source. A PWM technique is designed to ensure the natural balancing of capacitors voltages in open loop. No PI regulators or filters are needed which result in a very simple implementation. Operation of the topology including dynamics verification is validated through simulations in MATLAB/ Simulink.

articleTitle: Efficient, stable and low-cost hole transporting layer for Perovskite solar cells
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Among the new generation photovoltaic (PV), Perovskite solar cell technology reached top efficiencies in a few years. Researchers should achieve stability and process/material low cost to place the technology in the market. Among the different layers that compose a Perovskite solar cell, the hole transporting layer (HTL) plays a crucial role in terms of efficiency and stability. The reference and expensive Spiro-OMeTAD HTL has high efficiency but poor stability. The main scope of this work is to optimize the process to obtain efficient, repeatable and stable devices, by using the low cost and scalable X55 HTM (hole transporting material) that is emerging in the Perovskite solar cell field. We show a champion efficiency about 16% that is higher respect to the reference Spiro-OMeTAD case (about 15%). The results are also confirmed by IPCE spectra. Finally, we demonstrate for the first time in literature the stability of the material in humidity condition.

articleTitle: Raw material stock optimization and implementation of Kanban system
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: This is a paper presenting a case study of raw material stock optimization and Kanban system implementation in a company from the automotive field. This case study comes within the framework of many problems known in terms of raw material management like obsolescence, stockout and stock coverage variation between different raw material categories.

articleTitle: Implementation of a decision system to control the company-supplier relationship in the era of industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Within the framework of industry 4.0 many innovations have contributed to improving the company’s work organization and its productivity. In this perspective, the purchasing function has a key role regarding the company's absorptive capacity, and open innovation. Furthermore, Companies are invited to master the purchasing function operations, with a focus on mastering the relationship with suppliers, which are source of value creation and innovation. One of the most crucial operation is the selection of the right suppliers, based on both qualitative and quantitative criteria. However, few methods and tools are available to guide the decision-maker to make optimal choices considering total cost, delay and supplier's innovation. Therefore, we propose in this paper an implementation of a decision support system for a common optimum work between companies and suppliers, in order to promote innovation in the era of industry 4.0.

articleTitle: H-infinity Control of Bidirectional dc-dc Power Converter for V2G BEV Charger
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: This paper dealt with H-infinity control of the bidirectional dc-dc power converter for a V2G battery electric vehicle charger. This studied-system is composed of a bidirectional half-bridge structure associated with an electric battery via an LC filter. After an accurate modeling stage, a robust mixed-sensitivity H-infinity controller is designed to reach the three following control objectives: (i) ensuring the battery-charging process during the grid-to-vehicle operating mode; (ii) safeguarding and ensuring the battery-discharging process during the vehicle-to-grid operating mode; and (iii) guaranteeing asymptotic stability of the closed-loop studied-system. Finally, in order to validate the effectiveness of the proposed controller, numerous simulation scenarios are accomplished using the MATLAB/Simulink software which clearly illustrated that all control objectives are meet.

articleTitle: Design dual notched band UWB bandpass filter using hybrid technique and Split-Ring-Resonator
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: A novel compact dual band notch ultra-wideband (UWB) bandpass filter is presented based on hybrid technique using coplanar to microstrip technology. The proposed filter is mounted on a Flame Resistant 4 (FR-4) substrate with a thickness of 0.8 mm and loss tangent of 0.025. The basic structure is developed for covering UWB bandpass wherein coplanar on the top layer and microstrip in the bottom layer. Later, the split ring resonators (SRRs) are embedded in the bottom plan to generate dual notched band at 5.2 for WLAN band application and 8 GHz for X-band satellite applications. The results of the proposed filter show that the presented filter has high impedance matching S11 better than 15 dB and insertion loss $\mathrm{S}21 \lt0.5$ dB in the all passband. The UWB BPF shows a flat group delay which is about 0.31 ns in the whole passband. The proposed filter is a suitable candidate for UWB wireless devices.

articleTitle: Early Deep Detection for Diabetic Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a diabetic condition that affects the eyes and it could lead to blurry vision or complete vision loss. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been used increasingly for computer vision projects and medical image analysis. Past work has been done using deep learning models and frameworks to automatically detect diabetic retinopathy. However, such techniques used very large CNNs requiring enormous computing resources. Therefore, it is necessary to develop more computationally efficient deep learning frameworks for automated DR diagnosis. The main objective of this project is to build a reliable and computationally efficient deep learning model for the automated DR diagnosis. In this paper, a computationally efficient deep learning CNN is presented based on the DenseNet-121 neural network architecture that provides very deep CNN with lower computational resources using the concept of transfer learning. The model also detects the severity of the disease. The proposed deep learning model is trained and tested using the commonly used labeled retinal images data set and the cloud GPU provided by the community of data scientists and machine learners, Kaggle.

articleTitle: Energy Modeling for a Differential Guide Mobile Robot Using Simscape
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Very few models have been proposed for estimating the energy consumption of mobile robots using Multi-domain dynamic simulation. In comparison to the classical modeling, using this approach offers many advantages. In this paper, a complete energy model has been developed in Simscape software to illustrate that. The estimated energy consumption is compared with typical motor energy and mixed energy models. This comparison shows that energy losses in gearheads, and by friction must be taken into account to present accurate results.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of the Implementation of SJF and SRT Algorithms on the GPU Processor Using CUDA
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: GPUs (Graphical Processing Units) have become in a few years very powerful tools for the calculation of parallel tasks. They are currently used in several fields such as image processing applications and in bioinformatics and medical applications, video and audio coding and decoding, digital modeling. Their advantages are low cost, faster processing and lower power consumption compared to the equivalent power of the processor (central processing unit). It’s simple to program a GPU graphics processor using a programming language such as CUDA C to perform tasks that are typically calculated in parallel. But then you need to understand the different architectural aspects of GPU GPU. In this article, we will define and implement the Shortest Job First (SJR) and Shortest Remaining Time (SRT) algorithms in a single-threaded CPU environment using the C language, then the same algorithms are implemented on GPU using the CUDA language. C, in order to compare the different performances of the implementation of the two algorithms on the GPU and CPU processors and to ascertain the effectiveness of this study.

articleTitle: Ku-Band Lightweight Aluminium Waveguides Fabricated by Direct Metal Laser Sintering Process
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: This paper attempts to establish a good base for weight-reduction technique of microwave devices using 3D printing techniques. Experimental studies to minimize the weight of radiofrequency waveguides printed using additive manufacturing techniques are presented. Two types of Ku-band rectangular waveguides (perforated and full-metal) have been printed using direct metal laser sintering (DMLS) process. The insertion losses increased by $\sim 1.2$ dB/m after applying 1 mm grids which reduces the weight of Ku-band rectangular waveguide by $\sim 17.5$%. Comparison between these measurements and those of a waveguide manufactured by conventional method was used to determine process loss. The insertion losses of full-metal waveguide manufactured using DMLS process increase by $\sim 0.7$ dB/m compared to the conventional one. Finally, RF measurements of waveguides manufactured using DMLS process show a good agreement with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Early Fault Estimation of Inter-turn Short-circuit in Rotor Winding of WRIM using ANN-based Combined TSA and MCSA Technique
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: The wound-rotor induction machines (WRIMs) are commonly present in diverse systems like wind turbines. A small insulation defect between neighboring turns of the winding of a single rotor phase subsequently causes a large number of short circuits between the adjacent turns due to the vibration produced by this imbalance of the rotor. For this reason, an early survey of any little inter-turn short-circuits (ITSC) at different loads is established to remove posterior deterioration, minimizing the breakdowns of machine and maintenance costs. This paper advances a novel methodology to increase the reliability of condition monitoring (CM) of the incipient rotor ITSC defect in WRIM, which operating under changing load conditions, as though in wind-turbines practical application. The advanced methodology based on the combination of the Time-Synchronous-Averaging (TSA), Motor Current Signature Analysis (MCSA), and an artificial neural network algorithm (ANN) is developed. Indeed, a rotor fault cannot be recognized immediately by examining the stator current, exceptionally in the case of a short percentage of failure and a low load on the induction motor. The residual stator current and the frequency fault associated with the rotor fault are utilized as input for an ANN classifier to give a decision of rotor faults under different loads of the induction machine. The newly proposed monitoring technique has been verified using MatLab SIMULINK environment. The obtained simulation outcomes demonstrate that the suggested method can evaluate exactly some small percentage of shorted turns in the rotor winding of the wound rotor machine even at different loads.

articleTitle: Novel Hardware Architecture of EKF-SLAM's Jacobian matrices and its FPGA Implementation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) is a critical technique for autonomous navigation systems to build and update a map of the surrounding environment and estimate their own locations in this map. However, due to the computational complexity of SLAM algorithms, it is very difficult to achieve real time implementation on low resources and low complexity platforms. Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is an attractive real-time platform for SLAM systems as they are low power and high performance. In this work, we present a novel EKF-SLAM (Extended Kalman Filter SLAM) Jacobian matrices hardware architecture design and implementation on FPGA. We implemented the design using an FPGA Cyclone 2. The design can reach up to 112 MHz and uses 1517 logic elements, and it respect the real time requirements.

articleTitle: Direct computation to evaluate the capacitance of multiconductor transmission line
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: The first step in modeling the multiconductor transmission line (MTL) is to calculate the per-unit-length inductance, capacitance, and resistance parameters, capacitance is an essential parameter in MTL equation, because inductance is deduced from capacitance. In this paper, an efficient and fast direct computation algorithm is introduced to calculate the capacitance per-unit-length of MTL. The advantage of this new algorithm over the previous known ones is that the generalized capacitance always needed to obtain the capacitance per-unit-length is completely avoided, and can be used in the transmission line structure whatever the structure of the cables with arbitrary separate distance. Results obtained by the proposed algorithm match some of the known algorithms and with experimental data.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of a 4x4 beam former with a single crossover for 5G cellular network application
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: In this paper, we have studied and designed a beam former for the 5G mobile network, which operates within the band [3.4-3.8 GHz]. Our main objective is to control the phase at the output of the former, while ensuring better efficiency with the most compact dimensions possible. The results, in terms of phase and amplitude, that we have obtained in the 3.6GHz frequency are satisfactory and meet the exigencies of our application.

articleTitle: CNN Adaptations for Boat Detection in Aerial Images Tested on Yolo v2
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: In this article, we focus on boat real-time detection in aerial images taken by UAVs Unmanned Aerial Vehicles. Several methods dealing with this problem are based on convolutional networks. Generally, they start from existing networks that have demonstrated their effectiveness with datasets like COCO Common Object in Context [1] and adapt them to improve their performance on aerial images. The adaptations made should not cause a higher execution time than the initial network, especially if the image processing and detection must be done in real-time. They must also participate in the increase in Recall by detecting even small objects on aerial images which is the case of most objects present in photos taken at high altitude. The purpose of this article is to test the effectiveness of certain adaptations with our boat dataset. We will also propose new adaptations. The tests will be performed using the Yolo v2 neural network [2].

articleTitle: Real-Time Energy-Efficient Scheduling of Jobs and Maintenance in the Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Industry 4.0 is a new approach to organizing the manufacturing process. This new industry asserts itself as the convergence of the virtual world, digital design, management (operations, finance and marketing) with the products and objects of the real world. The use of real-time information in production scheduling decisions and energy-constrained maintenance is becoming possible thanks to new developments in information technology and industrial computing, such as Industry 4.0. The gradual implementation of Industry 4.0 in industries has led to an increase in the amount of energy consumed in industrial systems to operate various machines. In addition, the computational efficiency of these real-time embedded systems (RTES) depends solely on the timely completion of tasks. Performing production and maintenance tasks with reduced energy consumption within critical timeframes is a challenge for designers. However, energy efficiency and on-time delivery are two conflicting goals, since the former is only achieved with a significant trade-off of the latter. In this paper, we propose a new flowchart of the Real-Time energy-efficient Scheduling (RTEES) of Production and Maintenance System in Industry 4.0 based on optimization.

articleTitle: Detection of Surface Water from Satellite Imagery Using Deep Learning with Indirect Proxy Based Label Collection Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: This study encompasses the central idea of finding a deployable deep learning-based method to detect and monitor surface water using high resolution multispectral satellite imagery. A comparative study has been done between two different deep learning models varying in complexity (hidden-layers, layer-nodes) based on their accuracy and stability. An Indirect proxy-based data collection method is proposed in this paper which eliminates the overload and cost of manual data collection of surface water from ground-based surveys. Also, a comparative study has been done to check the sensitivity of model accuracy on data size, which clarifies the required size of training data-points and increases deployability.

articleTitle: Landscape Change Detection Using Auto-optimized K-means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: This paper presents landscape change detection for sustainable environment monitoring and planning of urban areas. An integration of principle component analysis (PCA) and K-mean algorithm is used in the study. The PCA offers the advantages of data redundancy, but results are difficult to interpret. K-mean provides an efficient interpretation of PCA results, but the selection of cluster K affects the detection results. Therefore, an automatic selection of the optimized value of K is proposed in the paper. A Calinski-Harabasz criterion in contrast to the Silhouette criterion is proposed to find the optimized value of K. The results are obtained for both Panchromatic and multispectral satellite images of Pune and Ahmedabad city of India respectively. The experiment analysis shows that the Calinski-Harabasz criterion gives an accurate value of K with better change detection in the images.

articleTitle: The Impact Study of Parameters and The Thermal Proprieties of The Polyamide 12 On The Temperature During the SLS Process
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Polyamide12 are characterized by good physical properties (thermal and electrical conductivity, etc.) and by mechanical qualities (elasticity, ductility, toughness).The key to understanding the laser sintering process is the knowledge of the thermal properties of the treated material (nylon12) and their influence on the thermal treatment of the part produced by the SLS machine, so to make a good mathematical modeling of this process, we must do a suitable modeling of the theoretical relationship of thermal properties and their evolution with temperature and the same thing of other parameters. this study shows the impact of the parameters on the evolution on the temperature in the SLS process, also the theoretical models of thermal conductivity of polyamide 12 and heat capacity, density will be requested and compared with other experienced work which measures these thermal properties of nylon 12.

articleTitle: Text to Code Conversion Using Deep Learning for NLP
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Semantic parsing is the problem of mapping natural language sentences to a formal representation like lambda calculus expressions. We work on a specific sub-problem in semantic parsing: producing python code snippets from natural language descriptions. We address this sub-problem using the CoNaLa Dataset in order to improve precision and to help developers in their development phases. For this task, we use Deep Learning (DL) for Natural Language Processing (NLP), based mainly on an Artificial Neuron Networks (ANN). Unlike the simple ANN, which learns in one direction, we use a Recurrent Neural Networks with LSTM cells since it performs better in Machine Translation (MT) task. We get a BLEU score of 15.2 beating the previously reported baseline of the CoNaLa challenge.

articleTitle: DOA and TOA of Network Adaptive Smart Antennas
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Adaptive smart antennas seem to be a promising way to increase the capacity of transmission systems. They are able to reduce the interference inherent in multipath, improve the signal to noise ratio, and introduce the reuse of frequencies. In this research, we studied the application of Matrix Pencil smart antenna systems for three network configurations: linear, circular and rectangular. We have developed an algorithm for estimating angle and delay based on Matrix Pencil method in order to eliminate multipath for linear network antenna. The Least Mean Squares (LMS) algorithm is applied for to direct the radiation pattern of the antenna toward desired signal. For the circular array, we chose the patch antenna circular segment as the basis for its integration in smart antenna systems. The designed patch antenna resonates in C-band [4–8] GHz at three frequencies. Then the DOA and TOA of the desired signal and interfering are accurately determined with the Matrix Pencil method.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Parallel Pipelined Pulse-Doppler Radar on Parallel-Embedded Computing System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Digital Pulse-Doppler radar signal processing chain (DPDR-SPC) is a computationally intensive chain. A massively parallel-embedded computing system was presented in this paper in order to meet real-time constraints. This system is based on sixteen digital signal processor (DSP) cores interconnected using Serial RapidIO (SRIO) protocol. A parallel-pipelined mapping model was proposed in this paper. In fact, this model has been optimized based on an efficient scheduling and mapping of the whole DPDR-SPC and an optimized SRIO communications approaches. In order to do that, the inter-processor communication time has been overlapped with computing time and data arrangements were performed using direct memory access (DMA). A use case of the DPDR-SPC has been experienced to prove the concept of the proposed mapping model. Experimental result shows a parallel efficiency of 80%. Compared to previous work, the proposed mapping technique is efficient and more scalable.

articleTitle: Slotted Patch antenna with dual notched bands for UWB applications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: A new ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna is presented in this paper. The proposed antenna shows the UWB operation in the frequency range of (3 GHz–13.5 GHz) with (S11 <-10dB) except the two notched bands centered at 4.6 GHz and 6.5 GHz. The 30 x 35 x 1.6 mm3 antenna is mounted on dielectric substrate FR-4 with thickness h=1.6mm, relative permittivity εr=4.3 and loss tangent of 0.025. In order to reconfigure the proposed UWB antenna to reject two bands, the final antenna design is based on inspired split ring resonator (SRR) and rectangular slots, positioned in the middle of the radiating patch. All the design and simulated results are performed using CST Microwave Studio and verified using another electromagnetic simulator HFSS. The results show wide bandwidth and good omnidirectional radiation patterns in the passband. The novelty of the proposed antenna is the ability to support UWB bandwidth requirements and to reject specific bands to avoid possible interference with existing communication systems.

articleTitle: Broadband ring dielectric resonator antenna for satellite and 5G applications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: In this work, a ring dielectric resonator antenna is designed, with a parasite strip placed in the inside surface of the ring, the dielectric resonator is an Acrylonitrile butadiene styrene mounted on Aluminum ground plane and excited by an adjacent coaxial probe for its ease of fabrication. The antenna is designed by using CST Microwave Studio and HFSS software. The result of simulation shows a wideband about 62.42%, the bandwidth of the structure is found ranging from 17.3GHz to 34GHz, which make it suitable for satellite and 5G applications.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Reconfigurable Frequency Antenna with Rejection Bands for UWB Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: In this paper, an ultra wideband antenna (UWB) with rejected bands is presented. To make sure that the proposed antenna has an UWB nature by covering the operating frequency band of [3.1 – 10.6] GHz, the rectangular slots are etched in the radiant square patch element of dimensions $8 \times 8$ mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Besides, the defected ground structure (DGS) method is used. In order to ensure the notching bands, two PIN diodes are integrated in the patch part of the proposed UWB antenna structure. The first one is embedded on the left top of patch part, while the second one is implanted in the right top of patch element. Depending of the integrated PIN diodes status, multiple frequency bands with different bandwidths are rejected. In addition, the proposed design shows a good stability in term of radiation pattern. These results show that the proposed design antenna is a powerful candidate antenna structure for ultra wideband applications with rejection bands avoiding the interference problem with the existing wireless system.

articleTitle: A comparative study of road infrastructure and 5Gbased cellular infrastructure in the case of a VANET network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: The evolution of the cellular networks has improved several functionalities used by the customers, the 5G which is their last generation, will allow the connection of several machines, which will result in the improvement of several fields in the Smart City and especially the one of the Intelligent Transport System (ITS). VANET is a promising ITS project whose aim is to provide wireless communication support to the moving vehicles; this network is mainly composed of two infrastructures, one of them is cellular, and the other is road-based; the objective of this paper is to make a comparison between the two infrastructures according to the criteria of capacity, security, coverage, reliability, and latency.

articleTitle: Efficient implementation of Background Subtraction GMM method on Digital Signal Processor
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Detecting moving objects based on real-time video processing is considered as a challenging task. The background subtraction using the Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) is one of the widely used technique. However, it requires high-computing power to meet real-time processing constraints. An efficient implementation of GMM algorithm on an embedded platform based on the C6678 digital signal processor (DSP) was proposed in this paper. First, an optimized GMM code has been developed for the proposed embedded platform. Then, an efficient memory management strategy has been implemented to ensure contiguous memory access. In addition, the compiler options have been enabled to take profit from loops unrolling and software pipelining to improve the computing performances. In order to evaluate the quality of our implementation, a metrics comparison have been performed based on the background truth images provided by the literature dataset references. Experimental results show important improvements over the optimized implementation of the state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized UWB Triangular Planar Antenna Inspired With Dual T-shaped and Single SRR Slots For WLAN and X-Band Filtrations
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: In this conference, we present a metamaterial inspired a regular triangular coplanar waveguide (CPW) UWB structure for dual band-filter characteristics. Initially, the frequency range operating is from 4GHz to 12 GHz. To supress the undesired WLAN (5-6GHz) and X-band (downlink) of satellite communication systems operating in the range of 7.25 to 7.75 GHz signals, we are loaded a single split ring resonator (SRR) and a symmetrical dual T-shaped slot metamaterials in the CPW ground plane respectively. The performance and results of the proposed slotted notch antenna are simulated and optimized both by CST Microwave Studio and Ansoft HFSS. To further analyze the effects of the T-shaped and SRR slots, the surface current distribution is used. The antenna gain againts frequency signal is good except the suppressed band regions while its value is negative.

articleTitle: Improved JPEG image watermarking in the data compression domain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: The joint photographic experts group (JPEG) is the most popular format among various digital image formats used in our daily life. Therefore, watermarking JPEG images is important and useful for many applications such as archive management and image authentication. Along with the embedding capacity and imperceptibility that have to be considered for uncompressed images, the storage size of the watermarked JPEG image should be considered. In this paper, based on the philosophy behind the JPEG encoder and the statistical properties of discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients, we propose a new JPEG image watermarking in the data compression domain, in which only coefficients with values 1 and -1 are expanded to carry message bits, coefficients with values 2 and -2 are shifted, and all the others coefficients remain unchanged. Moreover, a block selection strategy based on the number of 1 and -1 coefficients in each $8 \times 8$ block is proposed, which can be utilized to adaptively choose DCT coefficients for data hiding. Experimental results demonstrate that by using the proposed method, we can easily realize high embedding capacity and good visual quality. Furthermore, the storage size increase for the watermarked JPEG image is well lessened.

articleTitle: Proposed Ontology to Intelligent Road Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: A road network is a system of interconnecting lines and points that represents a system of roads for a given area. Some sections of the roads network have a special properties and they are usable by all types of vehicles. Others road are reserved for special vehicles. The ontology has been used for an explanation of any term and helps to value during the analysis of a new or unknown information. This paper proposes an ontology for taxonomy of a road network classes and their relationships taking into account the semantics of its segment (Board, Way, Pavement, Bridge, Subway or Tunnel, …) and their technical characteristics (Congestion, Validity, Security, …) in order to give appropriate solutions of some problems such as the travelling salesman problem (TSP). For this aim, we use the OWL (Ontology Web Language) for modeling our specific lightweight ontology. This ontology is supported by a complementary language SWRL (Semantic Web-enhanced Rule Language) and SQWRL (Semantic Query Web-enhanced Rule Language) to retrieve implicit road knowledge.

articleTitle: Enhanced Efficiency Of RF-DC Energy Conversion Using Tripler Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: This article describes the topology of the rectifier circuit designed for microwave contactless energy transfer used to convert RF into DC voltage. The RF-DC conversion analysis consists of a Schottky rectifier diode circuit using tripler topology. The rectifier circuit has been studied using advanced design software (ADS). The performance of this last has been evaluated at central frequency of 2.4 GHz.

articleTitle: Performances of the SHA-3 candidates implemented in the Zynq-7000 Artix-7 FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive comparison of all Round 3 SHA-3 candidates, aimed to be implemented in automotive Controller Area Networks, for better security and control. The hash algorithms comparison is performed with respect to the throughput value, the resource utilization and the throughput to area ratio. Furthermore, the power consumption is taken into account for a thorough analysis. In order to achieve this objective, the algorithms are implemented in ZYNQ-7000 XC7Z020 using VIVADO. As a result, all algorithms are ranked according to their respective overall performances with regard to the mentioned parameters.

articleTitle: Clustering The Customers By Using K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Advancements in new technologies have greatly assisted the retailers to struggle the challenge of providing customized services and building long-term customer loyalty. Moreover, the consumer analysis is the key enabler of a new wave of these personalized knowledge-based services. This gave birth to the idea of developing a geomarketing solution to integrate geolocalisation technics and Big Data analytics. In this proposed solution, customers are tracked using beacons that are set up in the store and personalized promotions are offered to the customers based on their shopping habits and purchase histories. The smartphone application detects the location of the customer inside the shop using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) signals sent by the beacons and the information is then sent to the server application for processing. The server application then sends personalized offers to the customer. By using customer’s movements, we will generate trajectory-ticket and use Q-analysis to explore the connectivity of aisles. For the clustering, customers are clustered by using K-means. Given these results, the system provides customized coupons and price discounts for each customer based on their previous preferences and behaviors. The geomarketing system helps the store’s managers to understand the customer and offer personalized promotions.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison between Exact Feedback Linearization and LQI Controllers for an DFIG
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: The balance between production and consumption is a major problem for the electricity transmission system operator. Any variation must be compensated by to produce or absorb active and reactive power. This paper presents a linear quadratic regulator with integrateur (LQI) and exact linearization feedback (ELF) controller for a doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) in order to track the reference of the active and reactive power. The ELF controller maintains the original model that is nonlinear and with the aid of the differential geometry, the model is linearized and the LQI considers the model of the DFIG is linear with terms of disturbances. The goal is to determine which controller gives acceptable results and requires less measurement sensors. Matlab/Simulink simulate the dynamic behavior of the DFIG under variable wind speed.

articleTitle: Ensuring High Availability Of Private Cloud Services By Integrating The Ipv6 Protocol
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Today, the world is migrating to cloud computing. The aim is to facilitate access to services for all users, and above all to ensure high availability and confidentiality. And this remains a major challenge for all types of service providers, as attacks continue to increase. So, while the world is comfortable using the services, it is faced with a number of attacks of all kinds. This requires several security efforts. As part of our work, we will propose new avenues that we can choose from in a private cloud environment to enhance high availability. While relying on the combination of IPV4 and IPV6 protocols. In addition, we will use a combination of the IPV4 and IPV6 protocols. So, in order to guarantee high availability, we have proposed a replication method using the IPV4 and IPV6 protocols. We will also discuss the encryption algorithm to be used during this replication. Finally, we will propose to adopt biometric access methods to cloud services in order to properly manage the elasticity function.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a RFID-Reader Microstrip Array Antenna for Indoor Localization Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: This paper presents the design of 2*1 and 4*1 RFID-Reader microstrip array antenna for indoor localization. The antenna performances influence the object’s correct location in terms of gain, bandwidth, and radiation pattern. The proposed 2*1 and 4*1 array antennas are composed of two and four identical elements, respectively printed on Epoxy FR4 substrate. Two feeding techniques are used to transfer the electromagnetic energy into the array antennas, which are the microstrip line feed and the coaxial probe feed. CADFEKO performed the simulation results of these designed array antennas. A performance comparison between the two feeding techniques for the 2*1 and 4*1 array antennas was made based on the S11, VSWR, bandwidth, and gain.

articleTitle: Predictive analysis using machine learning: Review of trends and methods
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been growing considerably over the last ten years. Machine Learning (ML) is probably the most popular branch of AI to date. Most systems that use ML methods use them to perform predictive analysis. This paper aims to conduct a literature review of trends and methods of machine learning used for predictive analysis. To do this, we carried out a collection of research papers from three scientific databases. We then considered selection criteria in order to study only papers published in the last five years, prioritizing those published in peer-reviewed scientific journals. This process led to the selection of 30 research papers that were considered for this review. The purpose of this study is to provide researchers, companies or anyone wishing to perform predictive analysis with clues that will enable them to choose the best ML method(s) according to its field of application, based on the latest research works in the literature. This study highlighted the most used methods by field of application: DT and ANN in education, LR, RF and DT in building, DT in botany, RF and ANN in social science and RF in medicine.

articleTitle: Intelligent machine vision model for defective product inspection based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: The accelerated growth of new technologies, along with the optimization of the manufacturing systems, are forcing companies to change their traditional methods of production and step up to industry 4.0. Quality control is one of the production processes most susceptible to be enhanced by introducing technological innovations. Accordingly, machine vision will be a critical part of automation systems in Industry 4.0. The data accessible by vision equipment will be used to identify and report defective products, understand the causes of deficiencies and allow rapid and efficient intervention in the Industry 4.0 factory. From this perspective, the machine vision model proposed in this paper combines between the identification of defective products and the continuous improvement of manufacturing processes by predicting the most suitable parameters of production processes to obtain a defect-free item. The proposed model exploits all data generated by various technologies integrated in manufacturing chain, thus meeting the requirements of quality management in the context of Industry 4.0, based on the predictive analysis to identify patterns in data and suggest corrective actions to ensure product quality.

articleTitle: An overview of Ethereum and Solidity vulnerabilities
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: The security of the Ethereum Smart contracts constitutes the most important step toward securing the whole blockchain since it is opensource and anyone can write and deploy malicious contracts and make profits from doing so. The immutable aspect of the blockchain makes it hard to roll back malicious codes to restore the state of the EVM. In this paper, we propose a taxonomy for the vulnerabilities of smart contracts written in solidity language. We also proceed with some simple simulations of some attacks and errors on smart contracts and we demonstrate how these vulnerabilities can tamper with the state of the Ethereum blockchain.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning approach for routing in satellite Mega-Constellations
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Current packet-switched networks, and Internet in particular, are experiencing explosive growth in traffic, mainly due to the rapid development of new communication technologies and the associated applications. Existing network routing policies might not be sophisticated enough to cope with the ever-changing network conditions resulting from huge traffic growth, opening to possible inefficiencies. Deep learning, as a recent turning point in the area of Machine Learning, has received significant research attention in numerous areas of Artificial Intelligence, such as Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, Autonomous Driving, Robotics Process Automation and so forth. Machine learning applications in network-related areas is relatively recent but it appears to represent an innovative approach to conFigure and manage networks in a more intelligent, efficient and autonomous way. On the other hand, we are witnessing as well the huge investments on satellite-based networks for global broadband Internet access, called mega-constellations, leveraging thousands of satellites in LEO orbit and expected to process Tbit/s. The aim of this paper is to describe the adoption of an innovative Machine Learning-driven and Data-driven approach applied to the routing of packets in such future generation of satellite mega constellations, enhancing services and applications QoS. In this work, we demonstrated the effectiveness of a Deep Learning based routing approach in comparison with the commonly used network routing approach of the Shortest Path, in a preliminary performance evaluation with few satellite nodes. The proposed approach can be applied to mega constellation satellite networks such as Starlink by SpaceX and conceptually applicable also to other (also terrestrial-only) networks.

articleTitle: On the LoRa performances under different physical layer parameter selection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Recently, various communication technologies have emerged to enable potential wireless connectivity between objects and allow data access for both short and wide-area communications. Among those, the low-power wide-area network (LPWAN) technologies that offer new types of services by enabling wireless objects to communicate efficiently through large scale networks and over long-range distances. Although LPWAN technologies are rising in the market, LoRa has shown tremendous attention. Lora is a long-range, low-power, wireless communication solution featured as an affordable infrastructure solution to tune the rapid growth of the Internet of Things (IoT) market. In this work, we have investigated the LoRa promising performances under channel medium impairments different physical layer parameters selection that affect the data rate, reliability, and range of communication among Coding Rate (CR), Bandwidth (BW), Spreading Factors (SF). The results proved that higher spreading factors offer better resistance to interference at the cost of increased airtime, and short coding rates offer significant performance at the cost of reduced packets size.

articleTitle: Applying Real-Time Object Shapes Detection To Automotive Traffic Roads Signs
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: This paper deals with a topical issue for researchers, namely the detection of objects in real-time. This is an important topic in the field of computer vision, as the detection and recognition of objects from images require very powerful algorithms. There are different ways to detect objects, for example, based on either the color or shape of the objects. The proposed approach consists in the realization of an algorithm to detect an object in the shape of a triangle, square, and rectangle, applied on traffic road signs for the automotive sector. Many detection methods can be adapted to progress efficiently and robustly, combining these different studies to find the best strategy. Besides, the use of numerous images in the test phase can be used to increase the accuracy of object detection. This approach could be interesting, can be established in the industrial sector, for the conception or development of embedded systems such as Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) integrated into autonomous vehicles. The objective of this approach is to help systems based on artificial intelligence for road safety, to have a high degree of accuracy with negligible errors for detecting traffic road signs.

articleTitle: Towards Optimal Spectral Efficiency of Cell Free Massive MIMO Based Linear Detectors in 5G
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: The 5G generation of wireless communication can make a radical change in how we use wireless things. This generation provides various developed features (very high data rates, ultra-reliable low-latency, high spectral efficiency (SE)), and several emerged technology to obtain higher performance compared to current 4G LTE networks. Cell-free massive MIMO is a key technology that has been used to enhance the SE, energy efficiency (EE), reliability, and quality of services (QoS), for 5G communications and beyond. This new paradigm consists of a large number of distributed access points (APs) that serve a small number of users in the network. Precoding/detectors are one of the most important components of cell-free massive MIMO systems to eliminate the problems of pilot contamination and inter-user interference. The aim of this paper is to carry out the performance analysis of SE of cell-free massive MIMO uplink (UL) receiver under different detectors, maximum-ratio combining (MRC), zero-forcing (ZF), and minimum mean-square error (MMSE), with imperfect channel state information (CSI) cases, in comparison with the performance of both small-cell massive MIMO and cellular massive MIMO systems in one simulation, taking into account the same parameters and same different linear receivers. The simulation results are discussed in detail and have confirmed that the cell-free massive MIMO system provides effective spectral efficiency by using both ZF / MMSE detectors compared to the cellular massive MIMO and small-cell massive MIMO systems, even under imperfect CSI.

articleTitle: Edge-Cloud Architectures Using UAVs Dedicated To Industrial IoT Monitoring And Control Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: The deployment of new technologies to ease the control and management of a massive data volume and its uncertainty is a very significant challenge in the industry. Under the name "Smart Factory", the Industrial Internet of Things (IoT) aims to send data from systems that monitor and control the physical world to data processing systems for which cloud computing has proven to be an important tool to meet processing needs. unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are now being introduced as part of IIoT and can perform important tasks. UAVs are now considered one of the best remote sensing techniques for collecting data over large areas. In the field of fog and edge computing, the IoT gateway connects various objects and sensors to the Internet. It function as a common interface for different networks and support different communication protocols. Edge intelligence is expected to replace Deep Learning (DL) computing in the cloud, providing a variety of distributed, low-latency and reliable intelligent services. In this paper, An unmanned aerial vehicle is automatically integrated into an industrial control system through an IoT gateway platform. Rather than sending photos from the UAV to the cloud for processing, an AI cloud trained model is deployed in the IoT gateway and used to process the taken photos. This model is designed to overcome the latency channels of the cloud computing architecture. The results show that the monitoring and tracking process using advanced computing in the IoT gateway is significantly faster than in the cloud.

articleTitle: BERT for Arabic Named Entity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: In the recent year, transfer learning and contextual word Embedding models have majorly improved the performance of several NLP tasks for many natural languages. In this paper, we tackle the Arabic NER task while exploiting the effectiveness of using a context-dependent and transformer based representational language model. We train Arabic transformer-based representational language models using BERT [1], and compare them to the pre-trained multi-lingual model by building and evaluating the resulted Arabic Named Entity Recognition systems. Our approach utilizes BERT as multi-layer bidirectional transformer encoder that helped in learning deep bidirectional Arabic word representations, by training and fine-tuning the pre-trained model to generate the most accurate NER system for our datasets. Our system achieved the accuracy of 0.91 which demonstrated that creating a language-specific model can improve the performance of a specific NLP task in comparison to already trained Multi-language model.

articleTitle: Lightweight blockchain network architecture for IoT devices
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: In this work, we elaborate a survey on the different implementations of the blockchain designed for IoT; we highlight the constraints of the IoT environment and the challenges of the blockchain to secure and facilitate the interconnection of heterogeneous devices. We propose a blockchain framework adapted specially for the IoT, a new lightweight architecture that meets the constraints of heterogeneous devices as well as their variances and low computational power in IoT layer. Our work consists of developing a new lightweight cloud-based framework adapted to the IoT environment that minimizes the energy consumption of the devices and secures communication and access to the private blockchain network.

articleTitle: A Modular Multi-interface Gateway for Heterogeneous IoT Networking
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: The massive deployment of Internet of Things (IoT) architectures and applications, in many fields over the last decade, has accelerated research efforts on low-power wireless connectivity protocols. Moreover, many standards have been introduced, highlighting the need to make data flow among different communication protocols and network interfaces feasible. To this end, devices like Gateways (GWs) play a crucial role in many IoT applications and will impact future developments and possibilities. In this paper, the design and deployment of a new modular and scalable GW architecture solution, suitable for a wide plethora of use case scenarios and useful as a starting point for many possible improvements and applications, is proposed. Experimental performance results are discussed, showing the roles of different interfaces in specific use cases in which the proposed this solution may be applied.

articleTitle: An Optimized And Intelligent Security-Based Message Queuing Protocol S-MQTT Applied to Medical IOT COVID-19 DATA Monitoring Platforms
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: According to what we are living with the Covid19 pandemic, which is a global crisis and which has impacted all domains due to its propagation. So, to reduce the risks of this pandemic we were able to create a secure medical IoT platform that monitors citizens' access to companies and a large area in a way that is more organized and secured to reduce the gravity of the Coronavirus pandemic. To access the corporate surface, we propose a medical implementation of the IoT based on the citizen geolocation and combined with facial recognition via Artificial Intelligence (AI). To complete the three principles of security (confidentiality, integrity, and authentication) we used the AES encryption algorithm to protect information exchanges between the system nodes utilizing the MQTT Protocol for communication. Result accumulate from our test was assessed dependent on handling time to see the adequacy and performance of the platform.

articleTitle: An New Constrained Protocol S-CoAP Applied to Optimize COVID-19 Medical IOT Intelligent and Security-Based DATA Supervising Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: The whole world is going through a specific situation which is difficult because of the COVID pandemic; therefore, several works have been carried out in several fields. As much as the researcher we are also supposed to follow the current context, the reason why we thought of developing a secure platform IOT medical, based on the CoAP protocol. Our approach is to measure the temperature of each citizen and then the verification of his identity by the combination of RFID tag and facial recognition based on artificial intelligence and if these tests are valid then the citizen can access the public area. The essential point of this platform is that we added a security layer on the CoAP protocol that allows encrypting data from end-to-end with the use of the AES algorithm.

articleTitle: The use of satellite in 5G networks: the technological step forward and perspectives due to the VIBeS project
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: 5G system is a really disruptive new concept of telecommunication network because it will make use of all the up to date technologies both at physical and network management layer. It will represent a revolution especially for what concerns the latter aspects in particular introducing the concept of slicing. Thanks to their peculiar characteristics satellite systems can contribute to realize this revolution, offering performance in some very important scenario that will guarantee to satisfy 5G target requirements. The VIBeS project, funded by ESA, has reached very meaningful achievements in this line. The paper summarizes the main outcomes of the project and draws the significant perspectives that are now opened.

articleTitle: A Constrained Chaotic Flower Pollination Algorithm for Solving ORPD Problem
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
abstract: Optimum reactive power dispatch (ORPD) is inevitable due to its significant role in the modern power system operation and control planning. ORPD is a highly complex, mixed integer, non-linear and constrained problem with discrete and continuous variables. In this present work, a hybrid flower pollination algorithm (FPA) based on chaotic theory was applied to tackle the ORPD problem. Like other metaheuristics, the original FPA often stagnates in local optima. In order to evade this shortcoming and improve the optimization performance, a sinusoidal chaos map was combined with the standard FPA. Moreover, owing to the various non-linear constraints in ORPD issue, a constraint handling technique named superiority of feasible solutions (SF) is embedded into CFPA. CFPA-SF was applied to ORPD problem considering a medium test system IEEE 57-bus for minimizing the real power transmission losses and voltage deviation as two objective functions. The generator bus voltages, tap setting transformers and shunt reactive power sources are set as control variables. The obtained experimental results and statistical test validate the capability and efficiency of CFPA-SF method in comparison to FPA and those approaches reported in the recent researches in solving ORPD issue.

articleTitle: Application of SARIMA for Prediction of Water Storage Levels for a Metropolitan Area: Chennai, a Case Study
publicationTitle: 2020 International Symposium on Advanced Electrical and Communication Technologies (ISAECT)
